subject: Tech Roundtable follow-up: credit allocation for NimbleHealth
messages:

Subject: Post-event attendee export & next steps

Kimberly / team —

Thanks again for sponsoring the Bay Area Tech Roundtable last week. Attached is the attendee export and the survey results (summary attached as CSV). I flagged attendees who attended the live demo and who booked a follow-up. Please confirm whether Redwood will be taking the full follow-up credit for demo-sourced leads or if we should split with the channel reps.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the list.

—Scott
EventWorks
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Scott Harris <scott@eventworks.com>, Erin Nash <erin.nash@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-event attendee export & next steps

Scott — thanks for the export. Erin, great meeting you at the roundtable.

Quick note on Redwood's standard post-event credit policy: for sponsored roundtables we give primary credit to the SDR/AE who ran the in-person demo or booked the follow-up directly at the event. If the demo came from our booth/session and the demo recording or demo-signup form ties to a Redwood rep, that rep gets 60% credit and channel/partner gets 40% unless there was a co-sell agreement.

I did a first-pass match on the CSV against our CRM — attaching my notes in Drive (link below). A handful of the folks who booked follow-ups were routed automatically to regional AEs (Ben/Vivek) based on territory rules; I flagged those.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-roundtable-2026
Attachment: none (see EventWorks CSV)

Can Ben/Vivek confirm the leads assigned to them and whether they want to request credit adjustments? If we need to escalate, we should include Marissa for final allocation — we have Q4 targets resting on this.

—Kimberly
Sr. Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-event attendee export & next steps

Thx — I pulled the HubSpot list and compared to the EventWorks export. Several of the follow-ups labeled as 'booked at event' were actually routed to my queue because of company domain rules; I have a screenshot showing 5 of the 7 conversions attributed to my outreach in HubSpot (see attached).

Ben's position: those 5 conversions should be counted as Redwood-sourced (Ben demo'd onsite and did discovery) and should therefore flow into the NimbleHealth pipeline for my rep credit. I understand Kimberly's 60/40 guideline; I'm arguing that when an AE ran the demo and progressed the opportunity onsite, they should receive primary pipeline credit, independent of how the registration form routed.

Attachment: ben-hubspot-view.png (screenshot of company records), referenced HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/companies/9314

Soojin — can you confirm routing logs for 11/17 so we can verify whether the demo bookings were reassigned before Ben engaged?

—Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-event attendee export & next steps — allocation decision

Team — thanks for the quick triage. I listened to the call excerpts and reviewed Ben's HubSpot evidence. Summary & decision below: 

1) Evidence: Ben demo'd on-site to at least 3 accounts that converted into MQL->SQL within 7 days; HubSpot timestamps and call recordings back up direct AE engagement. So primary credit to Ben for those 3 opportunities.

2) Policy exception: For the remaining event-driven bookings where we only had a session signup (no AE demo onsite) we will keep the default split (60% event owner / 40% channel).

3) Action items:
  - Ben: I'll approve a manual credit adjustment for the 3 supported opportunities. Please send me the HubSpot company IDs and the specific deal records by EOD Monday.
  - Soojin: pull routing logs (11/16-11/18) and confirm any late reassignments that could have caused mismatches.
  - Kimberly: update the roundtable post-event report and publish the final-triage workbook to Drive. I'll attach it to the Q4 pipeline rollup.

I attached the triage workbook with the final allocations. We will treat this as an exception precedent for this event because of the strong onsite AE involvement; track policy exceptions in the policy exceptions tab.

Attachments: final-triage.xlsx, call-recording-0922.mp3 (audio excerpt)

Marissa Cole
Field Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
